name: spacefrontiers
description: Compact, reranked retrieval over papers, books, patents, standards, Wikipedia, Reddit, Telegram, Discord, and YouTube. Four read-only tools return canonical source URIs for citation.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user spacefrontiers https://mcp.spacefrontiers.org

tools.name: spacefrontiers_search_documents
tools.description: Search papers, books, patents, standards, and Wikipedia. Defaults to 10 compact, reranked hits.

tools.name: spacefrontiers_search_social
tools.description: Search Reddit, Telegram, Discord, and YouTube transcripts. Defaults to 10 compact, reranked hits.

tools.name: spacefrontiers_fetch_document
tools.description: Retrieve bounded full text + references for one document by canonical URI.

tools.name: spacefrontiers_search_in_document
tools.description: Find up to five bounded passages within one document by text query.
